verdict.rationale: Algolia's own llms.txt lists AI Search (NeuralSearch) as 'Hybrid keyword + vector semantic search', and the llms.txt probe describes the platform as offering AI-powered semantic search alongside full-text search. That directly names the story's capability, but it is only a one-line product-catalog mention. missing for 10: in-depth docs showing keyword and vector results fused within a single query request, API/parameter details for enabling or tuning hybrid ranking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
